subject.title: Bug: Isolated cron job delivery.mode=announce fails with 'Channel openclaw-weixin does not support action send'

question: Should `message.action` with `action: "send"` become a generic core outbound send for plugins without `actions.handleAction`, or should isolated cron/source delivery be changed to avoid `message.action` entirely?
rationale: Both paths can plausibly fix the reported message loss, but they change different Gateway/plugin boundaries and need owner intent before an automated repair.

options.title: Route send through core outbound
options.body: Special-case Gateway `message.action` send to use the same durable outbound path as Gateway `send` when the channel has outbound support.

options.title: Keep message.action plugin-only
options.body: Leave `message.action` as a plugin-action RPC and change cron/source delivery so send announcements call the existing Gateway `send` or direct outbound path.

options.title: Require plugin handleAction
options.body: Ask the WeChat plugin to implement `actions.handleAction`, accepting that outbound-only plugins will still fail this Gateway RPC.

recommendation.title: Route send through core outbound
recommendation.body: Special-case Gateway `message.action` send to use the same durable outbound path as Gateway `send` when the channel has outbound support.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the clearest recent history on the Gateway `message.action` runtime-config path where the exact unsupported-action error is returned.
